audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Quinn six of seven stages, including first item and 2+ items, in a lane Kayle wins 52.73% and which the file calls 'where your reverse curve buries her'. whys[3] already says levels 4-5 tilt the lane Kayle's way.
audit.why: Packet levelChart reads Quinn / Quinn / Quinn / Kayle / Kayle / Kayle / Kayle. Quinn is front-loaded and finite; handing her Kayle's item stages inverts the entire point of the matchup.
audit.corrected: Rows 3, 4, 5 and 6 -> Kayle; rows 0-2 stay Quinn. Flipped in matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: Four spikes present and correctly sited: Quinn levels 1-3, Kayle 6, Kayle first item, Kayle 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Asserted in four places that Vault 'knocks you back and nearsights you'. Riot's text for Vault: Quinn dashes to an enemy, damages and slows it, briefly interrupts it, then leaps off and lands near her maximum attack range away — SHE repositions, the target is not displaced, and there is no vision effect. The vision hinder belongs to Blinding Assault (Q).
audit.why: The two abilities are on different cooldowns (Vault 12/11/10/9/8s, Blinding Assault 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s at 1025 range) and the counterplay differs: you dodge the Q line to keep your vision, and you punish the Vault by walking at her the moment she lands, because she has spent her only escape.
audit.corrected: Attribute the nearsight to Blinding Assault, describe Vault as a dash-slow-interrupt that repositions her to max range on 12s, and key the step-up to that landing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Vault is the tracked cooldown but its duration is never given.
audit.why: 12 seconds at rank 1 is the single most punishable window in this lane — she has no other escape from a ranged Kayle.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Vault's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Celestial Blessing heals her poke off and Radiant Blast shreds her resists — you stop bleeding and reach 6 on even CS.

edits.before: Level 6 / 11 / 16 are the actual matchups — everything before is stalling. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Quinn's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Divine Ascent matches her range and Divine Judgment blanks the all-in — walk at her the moment Vault lands, because it is 12s of nothing.

edits.before: Nashor's Tooth is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Vault's cooldown.
edits.after: Nashor's attack speed and E's missing-health waves out-DPS her flat, finite poke.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Quinn carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: You out-range and out-scale a front-loaded kit — her roams matter now, her duelling does not.

edits.before: - Quinn Vault: matchup-defining — Her self-peel. Respect it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Quinn Vault: matchup-defining — 12/11/10/9/8s dash that leaps her back to max range. Once it lands she has no escape — walk at her. - Blinding Assault: 9-11s nearsight, dodge the line. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Her E Vault knocks you back and nearsights you, shutting down any level-2 trade, and you have no dash to stick to her — concede the level.
edits.after: Vault dashes in, interrupts you and leaps her back to max range on 12s, and you have no dash to follow her — concede the level.

edits.before: Quinn's Harrier-marked autos and her E Vault (knockback + nearsight) out-poke and out-kite your short melee-range autos in every exchange — concede these levels and just touch-farm safely.
edits.after: Quinn's Harrier-marked autos, Blinding Assault's nearsight and a 12s Vault that leaps her clear out-poke your short melee autos in every exchange — concede these levels and touch-farm safely.

edits.before: Win levels 1-3 hard — Harrier-kite every trade, Vault away from your Q, and nearsight you off any walk-up to farm
edits.after: Win levels 1-3 hard — Harrier-kite every trade, Vault away from your Q, and Blinding Assault you off any walk-up

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are some of your weakest in the game and Quinn is built to abuse exactly this. Your autos are short melee range while her Harrier passive marks you for bonus damage and gives her nimble move speed to kite, and her E Vault dashes in, knocks you back, and nearsights you so you can't even see to retaliate. You cannot win an extended exchange and you can't catch her once she pulls away. Do not walk up to throw a Q (Radiant Blast) you can't follow up — just last-hit at Q range or under tower and eat the chip. Burn nothing chasing; she'll Vault over it and Harrier-kite away. Your only job here is to not die and not fall so far behind that you can't farm at 6.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are some of your weakest in the game and Quinn is built to abuse exactly this. Your autos are short melee range while her Harrier passive marks you for bonus damage and hands her move speed to kite, Blinding Assault nearsights you so you can't even see to retaliate, and Vault dashes in, slows and interrupts you, then leaps her back to her own max range. You cannot win an extended exchange and you cannot catch her. Do not walk up to throw a Radiant Blast you can't follow up — last-hit at Q range or under tower and eat the chip. Burn nothing chasing. Your job is to not die and not fall so far behind you can't farm at 6.
